simd_cesu8 1.2.0

Kiwix uses checked byte slices and the standard UTF-8 validator.
The default word scan and optional portable SIMD scan use safe array
reads. The crate forbids unsafe code and omits the simdutf8 dependency.

The lenient Java decoders accept Android's four-byte UTF-8 sequences
alongside modified NUL bytes and encoded surrogate pairs. Strict
decoding still requires the standard modified UTF-8 representation.
